title: test(auth): AuthProvider 401 re-check case waits on the re-check read with an explicit chain budget
body:
Fixes #32426
Refs #32420
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:AuthProvider 的「401 后重查会话」测试用例,改为先等重查请求真正发出,再等身份被清掉,等待预算由默认 1000 ms 改为显式的 10 s。
- 为什么改:调度全量跑里该用例在 Test UI 分片负载下耗时 1022 ms 才失败,原因是等待预算过紧,不是产品时序缺陷。
- 风险与回滚:仅改测试,断言一字未动;回滚即还原该文件。
- 先看:`ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/AuthProvider.test.tsx` 中 `CHAIN_MS` 常量与「the server answers "no session"」用例。
- 两分钟验证:在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/auth/src/__tests__/AuthProvider.test.tsx`,预期 20 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/AuthProvider.test.tsx`, test-only (`skip-changeset`):

- The "the server answers no session" case now first waits on the event it asserts on (the re-check `get-session` read reaching the fetch seam), then waits for identity to clear. Both assertions are unchanged; the trailing read-count `expect` is kept.
- The `waitFor` calls in the 401 describe (`signedIn`, the three re-check cases) carry an explicit `CHAIN_MS = 10_000` budget with the reasoning in a comment. A passing run returns as soon as the DOM says so; the budget bounds only a failure's wait.
- No skip, retry wrapper or quarantine; no assertion weakened.

## Tests

Premise check (not a product race): in `AuthProvider.tsx` the 401 subscription is registered by an effect keyed on `holdsSession`, and `loadSession` clears `sessionLoadInFlight` in the same continuation that sets the user, so by the time `signedIn()` sees "Alice" the subscription is live and the in-flight flag is down. The chain 401 -> `sessionEndEvents` -> `client.getSession()` -> `setUser(null)` has no timer or debounce; the red was only the 1000 ms default budget.

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/auth/src/__tests__/AuthProvider.test.tsx` (from `ui/`, under `os-verify-lock.sh`): 20/20 passed.
- Repeat x50 under shard-like concurrency: 10 batches of 5 simultaneous `vitest run --maxWorkers=2` processes of this file under the lock: pass=50 fail=0 (`Tests 20 passed (20)` per run).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth type-check`: exit 0.
- Ablation: not run (test-only change; no product behaviour changed).

## Acceptance notes

Landing is the expected file; the producer (`AuthProvider.tsx`) needed no change.

## Verification

Local gates: CI-owned families (Test UI shards, lint) are read from the PR check-runs; the `--commands` derivation for this diff lists only checker-health self-tests, none a PR verdict.
